title: Block Selection — multi-select + bulk delete
description: Framework-agnostic multi-selection for any vertical list (Notion-style blocks, table rows, cards). BlockSelectionProvider owns the selected-id set; wrap each item in SelectableBlock — thin top/bottom edge strips select on click (Shift = range, Cmd/Ctrl = toggle). Backspace/Delete bulk-deletes when focus is outside an editable, Escape clears, and a floating count toolbar offers Delete/Clear. Pure UI — the host owns the data and runs onBulkDelete(ids). Lifted from notion-page-clone's block-selection slice.
